Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production full-body 2D character texture for the Android assistant Salve.
Input image 1 is BOTH the exact identity and pose reference and the edit target. Edit ONLY the clothing. Preserve her exact original anime face, large turquoise eyes, white hair shape, head/body proportions, standing frontal pose, arm/hand positions, leg positions, height, crop and the soft detailed drawn linework. Do not redesign, age, sexualize or change the character. Same 1024 by 1536 portrait canvas and same subject placement, including the original boots reaching the bottom edge. Keep all limbs fully visible. Real transparent alpha background with no white rectangle, no shadow floor, no text, no logos, no second character. Original relaxed arms at her sides and eyes looking forward. Clothing changes must remain modest, charming and compatible with her original black/white/turquoise palette.
Primary request: replace the black daytime dress and boots with a cozy modest pajama outfit: soft pale lavender long-sleeve button-up pajama shirt, matching long pajama trousers covering the legs, tiny turquoise star embroidery on the fabric, white/turquoise soft ankle slippers in the same foot positions. Gentle cuffs, a small neatly tied turquoise ribbon at the collar. Preserve her face and hair exactly. No nightgown, no exposed midriff, no new pose. Output only the edited character with transparency.
